title: CoverPrune: Coverage-Driven Token Pruning for 3D VLMs via Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2608.13226v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While 3D Vision-Language Models (3D VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable spatial reasoning capabilities, they suffer from massive visual token counts that create severe computational bottlenecks during inference. Existing token pruning methods primarily rely on diversity-based selection, discarding similar tokens to maximize dispersion. However, in 3D environments, this approach frequently drops representative prototype tokens in favor of outliers, breaking the multi-view consistencies and geometric structures essential for spatial reasoning. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift for 3D VLM token pruning: from maximizing diversity to preserving visual evidence coverage. We introduce CoverPrune, a training-free framework that formulates inference-time token pruning as an Optimal Transport (OT) problem. To overcome the intractable combinatorial subset selection inherent in this formulation, we design the Feature-Spatial-Temporal (FST)

translated_title: CoverPrune：基于覆盖度驱动的3D视觉语言模型标记剪枝方法，通过最优传输实现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13226v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尽管3D视觉语言模型（3D VLMs）展示了显著的空间推理能力，但它们在推理过程中面临大量视觉标记数量，导致严重的计算瓶颈。现有的标记剪枝方法主要依赖基于多样性的选择，通过丢弃相似标记来最大化分散性。然而，在3D环境中，这种方法经常丢弃代表性的原型标记，而偏向于异常值，破坏了空间推理所必需的多视角一致性和几何结构。在本文中，我们提出了一种3D VLM标记剪枝的范式转变：从最大化多样性转向保留视觉证据覆盖度。我们引入了CoverPrune，一个无需训练的框架，将推理时的标记剪枝形式化为最优传输（OT）问题。为了克服该公式中固有的难以处理的组合子集选择问题，我们设计了特征-空间-时间（FST）机制。
tldr: 本文提出CoverPrune框架，通过最优传输将3D视觉语言模型的标记剪枝从多样性最大化转变为视觉证据覆盖度保留，从而提升空间推理性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoverPrune, a training-free framework that reformulates token pruning in 3D VLMs from diversity maximization to visual evidence coverage preservation via optimal transport, enhancing spatial reasoning.
